name: Okita Waka
source:
An incredibly lazy homeroom teacher. She's a "disappointing beauty," someone who is actually very capable but chooses not to try. Surprisingly, when students truly need her, she'll go the extra mile. She's rumored to be quite beautiful, but her complete lack of feminine charm in her daily behavior leaves everyone second-guessing.
